subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear Mr. Smith, We are pleased to inform you that your flight booking from New York to London on July 15th has been successfully confirmed. Your e-ticket details and itinerary are attached to this email for your reference. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. For any further assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, The XYZ Airlines Team
